items: 【Waterproof & Easy to Clean】This medium-sized women's cross body bag is made of lightweight, waterproof nylon fabric and features a soft lining to better protect your belongings from scratches. The material is not only waterproof and stain-resistant, but also easy to clean, so you can travel worry-free even on rainy days.

【Organized Storage】The women's crossbody handbags has 11 pockets, including 2 spacious main compartment, 2 front zipped pockets, 1 front open pocket, 2 side pockets and 3 inner pockets. Multi-pocket zipper design ensure your belongings are stored securely - no more rummaging around in your shoulder bag!
